title: Verify RustCrypto base16ct (constant-time hex) with Verus
description: Machine-checked proofs, in Verus, about the real code of RustCrypto's base16ct 1.0.0: its branch-free hex encode/decode routines produce the right digits, accept exactly the hex alphabet, and its decoder flags every invalid input. The executable code is copied verbatim from the published crate and checked token for token; you may only add proof code (proof blocks, asserts, lemma_* proof fns, aux_* spec fns). No assume, admit or external_body.

tasks.title: Lower-case encode_nibble emits the right hex digit
tasks.description: Prove base16ct::lower's encode_nibble returns lower_digit(n) for every nibble n < 16, with no arithmetic overflow for any u8 input. Edit src/lower_encode.rs.

tasks.title: Lower-case decode_nibble accepts exactly 0-9 a-f
tasks.description: Prove base16ct::lower's decode_nibble returns the nibble value for '0'-'9' and 'a'-'f' and 0xffff for every other byte. Edit src/lower_decode.rs.

tasks.title: Upper-case encode_nibble emits the right hex digit
tasks.description: Prove base16ct::upper's encode_nibble returns upper_digit(n) for every nibble n < 16. Edit src/upper_encode.rs.

tasks.title: Upper-case decode_nibble accepts exactly 0-9 A-F
tasks.description: Prove base16ct::upper's decode_nibble returns the nibble value for '0'-'9' and 'A'-'F' and 0xffff for every other byte. Edit src/upper_decode.rs.

tasks.title: Mixed-case decode_nibble accepts exactly 0-9 a-f A-F
tasks.description: Prove base16ct::mixed's decode_nibble returns the nibble value for any hex digit in either case and 0xffff for every other byte. Edit src/mixed_decode.rs.

tasks.title: decode_inner's error flag catches every bad pair
tasks.description: Prove that for decode_nibble outputs hi, lo (each < 16 or 0xffff), ((hi << 4) | lo) >> 8 is zero exactly when both are valid, and the output byte is then hi * 16 + lo. Edit src/decode_pair.rs.

tasks.title: Mixed-case decoding of a pair is correct
tasks.description: Combine the mixed decode_nibble specification with decode_pair_flags: a pair of bytes is flagged as an error exactly when one is not a hex digit, and otherwise decodes to hex_value(c0) * 16 + hex_value(c1). Edit src/mixed_pair.rs.
